description: This file defines a Spring MVC controller named ConfigurationController which manages various configuration settings in an admin interface of a web application. It includes methods for displaying and saving account configurations, email settings, and related menu setup logic.

classes.name: ConfigurationController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling configuration-related admin pages and actions.

methods.name: displayAccountsConfguration
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display account configuration settings page, fetching current configs or initializing defaults.

methods.name: saveConfigurations
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save or update merchant account configurations from submitted form data.

methods.name: displayEmailSettings
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display email configuration settings, loading existing or default values.

methods.name: saveEmailSettings
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save email configuration settings submitted by the admin.

methods.name: setConfigurationMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the current menu context for the configuration pages.

methods.name: setEmailConfigurationMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set the menu context specifically for email configuration pages.
